contract: Queue waiting has its own absolute 30-second deadline, including permit and blocking-executor queues.
Actual execution receives a separate full 30-second deadline measured at blocking-worker start; queue time does not reduce it.
Queue-only expiry becomes retryable after one-second cooldown; at most one attempt is Preparing for each key.
Waiting/Started/Expired transitions share a mutex, so a canceled queued operation cannot begin later.
Already-started failures and execution timeouts remain Failed, hold their permit until the worker returns and never accept late success.
The delayed Refresh uses current selection/settings and does not recreate stale entries.

executionWindowCorrection.reason: The earlier combined deadline could permanently fail a valid operation after a long queue wait.
executionWindowCorrection.executionStart: The real blocking worker, after the queue deadline check under the phase mutex.

lateStartGate.result: Passed original request deadline while still Preparing; released execution gate and received success.

executionWindowCorrection.lateResultSafety: The pinned task is retained when switching timers; the worker rejects results past its execution deadline even if an async timer is polled late.
